taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-01 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 332.5 | 0.52 | 0.52
2 | 601.3 | 6.89 | 7.41
3 | 359.9 | 16.01 | 23.42
4 | 286.0 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as K-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-01
Curve type: K-type
Aquifer depth: below 23.42 m (Layer 4, ρ = 286.0 ohm-m, unbounded at depth)
Recommendation: Target drilling below 23.42 m where resistivity drops to 286.0 ohm-m, suggesting a more conductive, likely water-bearing zone underlying the resistive Layer 2 cap; confirm layer 4 thickness and water strike with drill cuttings/geophysical logging during advance, as VES cannot resolve its lower boundary.
